services.title: Seemantham
services.description: Celebrate the beautiful journey into motherhood with emotional maternity and traditional ceremony photography.
services.longDescription: The transition to motherhood is sacred. We capture the gentle clang of glass bangles, the warm smiles of elders blessing the mother-to-be, and the intimate emotional bond between the couple as they prepare for the new addition to their family.

services.title: Thottil Vizha
services.description: Capture the joy, blessings, family emotions, and precious moments of the baby's cradle ceremony.
services.longDescription: The baby's first introduction to the family circle is filled with soft whispers, tiny smiles, and traditional lullabies. We frame the beautifully decorated cradle, family elders placing the baby, and the surrounding warmth of a home filled with new life.

services.title: Peyarsutu Vizha
services.description: Preserve the beautiful memories of your child's naming ceremony with elegant and emotional storytelling.
services.longDescription: A child's name is their first identity. We capture the sacred moment of whispering the name in the baby's ear, the lighting of the traditional kuthuvilakku, and the expressions of joy as relatives hear the name proclaimed.

services.title: Kaathukuthal
services.description: Capture the traditions, blessings, family gatherings, and cultural emotions of the ear-piercing ceremony.
services.longDescription: A traditional milestone deep-rooted in Tamil custom. We capture the lively temple gatherings, the comforting embrace of maternal uncles (Thaai Maaman), the teary eyes, and the subsequent celebratory feasts that bring extended families together.

services.title: Nichayathartham
services.description: Capture the joy, excitement, and beginning of your wedding journey.
services.longDescription: The formal promise of union. We focus on the vibrant plate exchange, the glittering rings, the shy glances between the couple, and the initial meeting of two families uniting as one.

services.title: Penn Paarkkum Padalam
services.description: Preserve the warmth and emotions of this important family tradition.
services.longDescription: A subtle, deeply intimate family event. We capture the beautiful domestic aesthetics, the gentle passing of coffee cups, the nervous smiles, and the authentic first interactions of families finding common ground.

services.title: Muhurtham
services.description: Capture every sacred detail, ritual, emotion, and meaningful moment.
services.longDescription: The ultimate focal point of a Tamil wedding. From the early morning Kasi Yatrai to the sacred tying of the Mangalsutra (Thaali) under the chants of priests, we capture the raw intensity, cultural depth, and pure magic of the union.

services.title: Thirumanam
services.description: Tell the complete story of your wedding day through cinematic photography and storytelling.
services.longDescription: Comprehensive editorial coverage of your wedding day and reception. We paint a vivid cinematic tapestry of the grand setups, the couple's modern portraits, and the joyful greetings of thousands of guests.

services.title: Kalyana Virundhu
services.description: Capture the happiness, family connections, celebration, food, laughter, and unforgettable moments of the wedding feast.
services.longDescription: No Tamil wedding is complete without the feast. We photograph the traditional serving on banana leaves, the steam rising from local Trichy delicacies, the laughter shared across tables, and the simple joy of breaking bread together.
